evidence.quote: Information Technology and Data Communications - Amphenol is a global provider of interconnect solutions to designers, manufacturers and operators of internet and artificial intelligence (“AI”)-enabling systems.

The Company’s products include antennas, cables, connectors and interconnect systems that are used in current and next-generation wireline and wireless communications standards, including 5G networks.

The Company estimates, based on recent reports of industry analysts, that worldwide sales of interconnect, value-add cable assembly, antenna, cable and sensor-related products were approximately $500 billion in 2025.
